verdicts.reason: Held official-PDF text identifies EO 12278 and Federal Register page 7917; continuation is page 7918.
Section 1-101 expressly compels the described transfers to FRBNY's Bank of England account.
Section 1-102 contains the cancellation and transfer commands. OCR line disorder does not obscure those operative words.
Section 1-103 expressly conditions return of assets and restoration of set-offs on failure of prompt transfer to Iran.
Section 1-104(a) performs the revocation itself; section 1-108 makes the order effective immediately.
Section 1-104(b) both nullifies specified rights and bars their subsequent exercise.
Section 1-104(c) imposes the prohibition without an express expiration. This alone does not establish cutoff-date operation.
Reading all three cited sections confirms acquittance and good-faith immunity, required intervention, and the Treasury delegation.
The cited Cornell section states the January 20, 1981 deadline; it does not establish performance.
Held EO 12294 section 8 ratifies orders 12276 through 12285; the instrument does not expressly revoke or supersede EO 12278.
Cornell displays the corresponding prohibition in 535.218(c). This confirms the displayed rule, not its point-in-time status on October 14, 2026.
Cornell's 535.440 authority citation expressly includes EO 12278, 46 FR 7917.

The official November 5, 2025 notice continues the EO 12170 emergency for one year beyond November 14, 2025, covering the cutoff. It does not individually establish continuing operation of EO 12278's commands.
Both Cornell authority notes omit EO 12278; 535.220 names it in its text and 535.218 reproduces the relevant prohibitions.
